summary: Frontend-only mobile web validation completed for chat route restyle on /chat/test-conversation. Chat layout remained stable across load/reload, custom header rendered with required controls, encryption banner rendered below header, and composer row controls rendered with no blocking runtime errors.

integration_issues.issue: Route rendered 'Conversation unavailable' state for test conversation (expected for invalid/non-accessible conversation in unauthenticated preview), so live message list/bubble interactions were not exercised end-to-end.

issues: Header action tap targets use 36x36 and composer utility icons use 38x38, below recommended 44x44 minimum touch target for mobile accessibility.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings persist in preview (expo-notifications web listener unsupported, deprecated shadow*/textShadow* style props, expo-av deprecation warning).

action_items: Increase chat header/composer secondary icon touch targets to at least 44x44 while preserving screenshot-matched visual style.
Run one authenticated conversation regression to validate live message bubble rendering/actions after the restyle.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx is significantly oversized (>700 lines), reducing maintainability and violating modularity guidance.
Duplicate message-bubble implementation remains in chat screen while MediaBubble is also used; this is a DRY violation and creates divergence risk.
Wallpaper/bubble appearance system is still wired via normalizeChatAppearance/getWallpaperColor and MediaBubble appearance props, matching preservation requirement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Restyle acceptance checks passed for structure/stability in unauthenticated preview. Remaining gap is authenticated live-conversation validation and touch-target accessibility polish.
rca_of_issue: No crash/runtime blocker reproduced. Missing live message rendering in this run is due to invalid/non-accessible conversation route context, which correctly falls back to the 'Conversation unavailable' state.
